system.description:
Use this Nanogram Pattern with a Resolve (Operate) Test, Difficulty 2.

If successful, your nanoswarm discharges a potent electrical shock on an enemy nearby (in combat, within your zone). This is counted as an attack; enemies with a reader lens, or otherwise able to see data, can defend against this attack, turning it into a contest opposed by their Brawn (Survive). If the attack is successful, the target suffers a shocked Injury, with a damage rating equal to your Tech Level.
